original.text: phung po khams dang skye mched dbang po rnams/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i rang bzhin las/ /ma lus de las byung zhing de ru thim/
original.edition: Derge Tengyur (sde dge bstan 'gyur), digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling, Tōh 2281; Wylie by the unit (pyewts)
original.licence: Public domain (Derge xylograph; Esukhia/Barom digital edition, per the repository)

paraphrase: The aggregates, elements, sense-fields and faculties all arise from the nature of the innate and dissolve back into it; do not ask about the innate as thing or no-thing; emptiness and compassion are held to be of one taste there.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan
notes: Refs are the unit's sequence numbers within the short text.

original.text: lha rnams ma mchod 'bab stegs ma 'gro zhig /lha rnams mchod kyang thar pa thob mi 'gyur/ /rnam par mi rtog sems kyis sangs rgyas mchod par gyis/
original.edition: Derge Tengyur (sde dge bstan 'gyur), digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling, Tōh 2281; Wylie by the unit (pyewts)
original.licence: Public domain (Derge xylograph; Esukhia/Barom digital edition, per the repository)

paraphrase: Do not honour Brahmā, Viṣṇu and Maheśvara while awakening is in oneself; do not worship gods or go to bathing places — worshipping gods does not bring liberation; worship the Buddha with a non-conceptual mind; do not abide in existence or in nirvāṇa.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan

paraphrase: As one who has eaten poison is not killed by the poison, so the yogin who consumes existence is not bound by the pleasures of the senses; do not disparage action; it proceeds there in four moments and four joys — know the distinctions of the moments and joys; the innate is to be realized at the moment between the supreme joy and the joy of cessation.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan
notes: Summary; the text's line on the source of the knowledge is not reproduced.

original.text: yid ni gang du 'gro 'dod pa/ /de la 'khrul par mi bya'o/ /mig ni mi 'dzum pa dag gi/ /bsam gtan gyis ni gnas par bya/
original.edition: Derge Tengyur (sde dge bstan 'gyur), digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling, Tōh 2281; Wylie by the unit (pyewts)
original.licence: Public domain (Derge xylograph; Esukhia/Barom digital edition, per the repository)

paraphrase: Here are the four bodies and the four seals; then the whole of the three realms is pure; in the stainless innate there is neither virtue nor non-virtue; wherever mind wishes to go, do not err about it; with eyes unblinking, remain in meditation.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan
